youtube.title: Why Ice Floats (And Why It Saves Fish) 🧊 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Water expands by about 9% when it freezes, because hydrogen bonds hold the molecules in an open hexagonal lattice. Ice is therefore less dense than liquid water and floats. Lakes freeze from the top, and the ice layer insulates the water below, so aquatic life survives winter.
